limits: From 2021 to 2025, 18 reported flood barangay-days fall on 5 distinct days, so the evidence is closer to 5 days than to 40,172 rows.
With 5 such days, no model can be shown statistically better day by day: one that does better on all 5 days reaches at best p = 0.0625 on a two-sided sign test.

Rain comes from one NASA POWER grid cell (about 55 by 69 km) for the city's 22 barangays, and the cell's edge at 10.25° N runs through Talisay, so part of the city lies outside the cell it reads and local downpours can be missed.
An empty barangay-day means no flood was reported, not that none happened: every chance is of a reported flood and reads lower than how often floods really happen.

The two-part model's flood shares use UP NOAH flood hazard maps, which are labelled beta, rest on about 30 years of rain and come from a community mirror; the Mananga River works planned for 2026 would change river-flood hazard, and the maps do not show them.
The 15% and 25% cut-offs and several earlier choices were made after seeing 2023–2025, so the 2026 season is the clean test.

limits: From 2021 to 2025, 8 reported landslide barangay-days fall on 8 distinct days, so the evidence is closer to 8 days than to 40,172 rows.
With 8 such days, a model that does better on all 8 days reaches p = 0.007812 on a two-sided sign test; doing better on fewer of them is weaker evidence.

Rain comes from one NASA POWER grid cell (about 55 by 69 km) for the city's 22 barangays, and the cell's edge at 10.25° N runs through Talisay, so part of the city lies outside the cell it reads and local downpours can be missed.
An empty barangay-day means no landslide was reported, not that none happened: every chance is of a reported landslide and reads lower than how often landslides really happen.

The two-part model also learns landslide timing from NASA's Global Landslide Catalog, which states no licence, often places an event only to within 5–25 km, and covers 2007–2017, not the years the forecast is for.
The 15% and 25% cut-offs and several earlier choices were made after seeing 2023–2025, so the 2026 season is the clean test.
